name: figma-comment
title: Figma Comment
description: Small avatar pins sit on a mock design canvas. Clicking one expands it into a rounded card showing who wrote it, when, and their comment, and an outside click closes it.
use: Reviewers need to leave or read notes anchored to a spot on a design, mockup or prototype.
avoid: You need a threaded conversation with replies; the card shows only one author and message.
a11y: The pin is a div with a click handler, so it cannot be opened from the keyboard or announced as a control. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Round avatar pins scattered over a dark mock landing page. An open one becomes a dark rounded card with the avatar at its top left, a bold name, a muted time, and a few lines of light message text.
behaves: Clicking a pin spring-expands it into the comment card while the avatar slides in from the corner. The text fades and unblurs into place, and clicking outside collapses it back to a round pin.
customise: Author, avatar, message, timestamp, width and position class are all props. Card colours, radius and the spring are set in the source.
weight: light: One avatar, a short card and a single spring plus blur transition; nothing loops.
demo: Mock landing hero labelled 'Landing / Hero: Desktop' with comments from Maya Chen, Leo Park and Ana Ruiz.
issues: The pin trigger is a non-focusable div, so keyboard users cannot open a comment.
Frame 5 catches the card mid-blur, so its text is not readable.
polishWhy: Crisp spring expansion and blurred text reveal; pins read clearly against the dark canvas.
